testcase.name: Scenario: Preserve Tools panel choices while switching to Home: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:406:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Preserve Tools panel choices while switching to Home ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and the Home workspace is available in the MCAD Software ✔ And the part is active with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Tools panel selector is open ✔ And Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find and Team Web are checked ✔ And Tutorials is unchecked ✔ When the user selects the Home workspace tab ✔ Then Home is displayed and the part panel selector is no longer visible ✔ When the user returns to the part document tab ✔ Then the Tools ribbon is visible and the panel selector is closed ✔ When the user opens the Tools panel selector ✔ Then Measure, Material and Appearance, Options, Clipboard, Find and Team Web are checked ✔ And Tutorials is unchecked ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the panel selector closes ✔ And the part and Tools ribbon remain visible
